title: Understanding the Problem
text: You need to select the histogram that best visualizes the distribution of the sample median from a bootstrap sample of $$10$$ differences.

title: Bootstrap Distribution
text: The bootstrap distribution of a statistic (like the median) is created by resampling with replacement from the original data and calculating the statistic for each resample.

title: Characteristics of the Median
text: The median is less sensitive to extreme values compared to the mean. This affects the shape of its bootstrap distribution.

title: Analyzing the Histograms
text: Look for a histogram that represents a distribution of medians from resampled data. It should be less variable and more centered compared to the original distribution.

title: Selecting the Correct Histogram
text: Which histogram best represents the distribution of the sample median from the bootstrap samples?
